recommended_change: Decouple matrix input readiness from postproc output readiness. Redefine top-level channel-ready logic so mat_ready is driven by control-phase legality (busy/no-error/vector-loaded/compute phase) and not by pp_in_ready. Keep pp_in_ready only as acceptance control for postproc input pulse generation (pp_in_valid timing) and bias path where applicable. Ensure transfer pulses remain strict ready&&valid and counter/state progression remains unchanged except for removal of circular stall dependency.
do_not_change: Do not modify frozen tests or reference model.
Do not alter any module port lists, parameter contracts, or top-level signal semantics.
Do not change arithmetic behavior (INT8 signed multiply, INT32 wrap, optional bias/ReLU).
expected_side_effects: Matrix ingestion will proceed instead of stalling on output-side backpressure.
After unblocking handshake, subsequent functional mismatches (if any) may surface in accumulation/postproc sequencing and must be checked by regression.
